Nothing is compiled or checked, so the repository is left with a Regular Expression pattern that can never match and the {index} placeholder of the External Issue Tracker can never be filled from it.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open /eval/agent13-tpl-all2/settings (a repository of mine, agent13-tpl-all2).

In Advanced Settings, under Issues, tick "Enable Repository Issue Tracker", select "Use External Issue Tracker", fill External Issue Tracker URL with https://example.com/issues and External Issue Tracker URL Format with https://example.com/{user}/{repo}/issues/{index}.
Under "External Issue Tracker Number Format", choose "Regular Expression (ISSUE-\d+)" and type a single "[" into "Regular Expression Pattern".
Click the "Update Settings" button of the Advanced Settings form.
The page reloads with the message "The repository settings have been updated." — the invalid pattern "[" is accepted, saved and shown again in the field, with no error.
